text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... hehe, how was that? Did I fulfill my role properly?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally. I mean, that was perfect.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fura’s outfit couldn’t be changed backstage in time, so... you did it on stage? Like, with magic? Being able to pull that off so suddenly is insane.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I was unsure if I could pull it off myself, but... that’s exactly why I had to challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Even someone like me who’s used to the stage still feels anxious. So, it’s okay.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what!? All of a sudden!? You’re too close!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don’t hide it. You’re trembling.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... haha, that huh? Well, I’m the closing act, you know? So of course I’d be a little nervous, or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. You don’t need to worry about that. Just show what you’ve been working on.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That’s how I am too. To become a true entertainer... that’s the only thing I’ve aimed for, and that’s why I’ve made it here today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It’s all thanks to everyone. Each of you supported one another and didn’t give me any time to meddle around.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Because of that, I could focus on improving myself. To reach greater heights. To become an even more captivating 'Fuji Kiseki'—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Watch closely. Thanks to all of you, this time... you’ll see what kind of 'me' I can show.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Wha... animals!? She’s handling that many by herself... huh!? Wait, are these holograms!? Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Her miming is incredible!!! It’s like... there’s a real lion right there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Ah... smiles. Smiles. Smiles. From here, I can see them clearly. Everyone’s surprise and joy.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...I’m still not perfect. As an entertainer, the ideal I aim for is still far, far ahead on this path.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Even so, today I’ll celebrate. To the fullest. From the bottom of my heart! Because—)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ——Ahaha. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Once again, I became everyone’s 'miracle.')

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Heh... seriously, what was that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That was freaking awesome.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I think I get it now... why that guy keeps chasing after Fuji.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (It’s because they keep challenging themselves. Cool people... they keep striving toward the place they want to reach.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That’s why... their back, too—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! I’ll do it! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Doesn’t matter if I’m the closing act or not. I’ll show it. The me that doesn’t run away!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh... what? A blackout? It’s getting dark... did something happen...?

text_block_list.name: Uma Girl A
text_block_list.text: T-this is bad...! The generator broke down, and it looks like we don’t have enough power supply...

text_block_list.name: Stage Crew
text_block_list.text: We’re pulling external power, so things like air conditioning are fine, but... the lighting. The stage lights seem to be out.

text_block_list.name: Stage Crew
text_block_list.text: For now, we’ll explain to the audience that the lights went out... but what do we do? The final act depends on projection mapping, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That’s right... the performance depicts a tranquil deep sea illuminated by a single ray of light, where all performers show their acts together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We could force it using flashlights to light up the stage, but... it would lack both direction and safety. Without the equipment, we can’t meet the goal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...But still. Giving up would be the real joke, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I haven’t shown everything yet. I don’t want it to end without doing what I’ve worked for!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We still have 5 minutes and 13 seconds before the final act begins—let’s think. That’s the best move we can make right now.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Aha. Ahahaha☆ Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...??? What’s the matter, Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Look! The audience! The stars! They’re shining so bright☆★☆
